dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent, sharp pale boundaries along the distal edges of folded secondary and primary flight feathers against dark brown feather centers.

other_distinctive_markers: The bird exhibits a highly repetitive imbricate pattern across the dorsal surface where each feather has a dark center and a high-contrast pale margin; a light-colored, hooked beak is partially visible.
